filterSummary: Selected 10 videos (5 English, 5 Arabic) across 5 topics in number theory and cryptography. The English selections are dominated by highly popular channels like Neso Academy and Eddie Woo, often exceeding 500k views. The Arabic selections are also strong, with clear winners for each topic, including a standout RSA video with over 500k views. All selected videos are highly relevant, meet all quality gates, and directly address the specified student difficulties.
